conventions.data_order: Each volume is flattened x-fastest (Fortran order), matching NIfTI storage.
conventions.scaled: nibabel img.get_fdata(dtype=float64) (scl_slope/scl_inter applied per nibabel rules).
conventions.affine: nibabel header.get_best_affine(): sform if sform_code != 0, else qform if qform_code != 0, else base affine.
conventions.null: NaN or infinite header floats are serialized as null.
